title: Build the optional whole-service Go cargohold candidate

acceptance_criteria.description: Runnable optional whole-service implementation preserves the approved HTTP, federation, S3, configuration and operational boundaries.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Complete implementation against the existing matrix with exact binary/source identities; no Haskell defaults or oracle edits.

acceptance_criteria.description: Candidate formatting, build, vet, unit/race/security and dependency checks pass.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Actual Go check output and retained evidence. Whole-service parity/switchback verification remains separately owned.

evidence.command: Full go/check.py cargohold passes formatting/tidy/verify/vet/race/build/module-vulnerability/license checks at this revision; raw output retained. Original 27 selected tests passed at f410fca816fdca360720ca3565143a88a49185a7; 25 strict supplemental comparisons/switchback cases pass current bcbcd code with source 7044e09e43f0716400ffd5bb046a5d9ac6196f06 controller. Remaining full-service matrix explicitly incomplete.

handoff: Active whole-service candidate. Retained original 27 pass older binary; 38 core, 35 extended and 11 configuration comparisons pass their exact recorded candidate revisions. Current source 41226a9ad92b180e4ed9d43961aafbb130f03fc6 fixes the last ingress error Content-Type difference. Actual signed path/auto/virtual/override/ingress/Scality reads, CloudFront independent verification/invalid-key rejection, 24 MiB S3 upload, five S3 faults/abort effects and original auth/parser replay verified. Optional non-root scratch image startup and full Helm render selection verified; post-renderer preserves original test hook and omitted default. Still require mixed-runtime federation, audit-inclusive switchback/token metadata copy, cancellation, metrics and bounded load/drain, final original suite and full quality/review. No whole-service compatibility claim.
